implementation: Each fitted viewport owns a full-canvas depth-enabled SubScene, clipped after rendering and composed by a parallel-camera outer scene. Mesh/atlas buffers and original nodes are retained.
Null inner fill makes empty pixels native pick misses. Default-eye perspective coordinates preserve the compiled projection and make nested screen projection of the image plane the identity.
Mounted snapshots temporarily change size, antialiasing and background then restore the live view. Unmounted snapshots release their temporary scene. A second live mount is explicitly rejected.
scope: Static cortical cases exercise the integrated render/clip/camera path; later edits concern snapshot mount ownership and the public camera accessor. The complete update matrix, native lifecycle and final conformance exercise the final backend sources.

The imageJS conformance attempt initially reported missing image4s.geometry imports and cascading cyclic references. Direct compile and the entire conformance gate passed on retry without source edits. The initial failure remains in the log.
Legacy admission is a compatibility gate. Its synthetic vertex-color fixtures and buffer-read pick path do not establish performance of new scalar/categorical policies or native ray performance.
Inner render targets add GPU color/depth memory beyond primitive mesh/atlas byte accounting. Cortical dispatch observations are single samples, not latency percentiles.
visualReview: Reviewed native/reference bilateral clipping rectangles, transparent resized output, curved cortical overlay and lit categories. Original scientific maps and comparison metrics are preserved; 18 selected PNGs are archived.
remaining: Repeated new-policy admission at 32768 and 163842 vertices
Final full-plan requirement audit and documentation/receipts
